name: instant-worker — expiry deprovision failing (30m) [orphan infra accumulating]
description: Fires on a sustained non-zero rate of instant_expire_deprovision_failed_total. The 24h-TTL reaper marks anonymous/free resources deleted and asks the provisioner to tear down the physical backend (DeprovisionResource). When that teardown errors, per MR-P0-1a (BugBash 2026-05-20) the reaper LEAVES the row in its reapable status (it is NOT marked deleted) so the next tick retries — preventing a namespace/DB leak. A single transient failure self-heals on the next sweep; a SUSTAINED non-zero rate means the provisioner is failing teardowns and customer infra (k8s namespaces, customer DBs, Redis ACL users) is accumulating unreclaimed — a slow capacity leak. P1: recoverable but unbounded-cost-if-ignored. Source: worker/internal/jobs/expire.go reaper; counter ExpireDeprovisionFailedTotal in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go.
